issues.what: The study's headline positive claim — 'session memory beyond the hour effect, in the mean-reverting direction' (the reported key_numbers.direction, FINDINGS.md sections 0/3/6, findings.json headline / direction / decision / session_memory_null_rejected.minute=true) — is contradicted by the folder's own completed repair round, and the FINDINGS.md / findings.json on disk are the pre-repair versions. The N1 permutation null shuffles outcomes over FIXED positions, but positions are generated by outcomes (winners hold ~6x longer: bars_held_win_mean 110.6 vs loss 18.7, real; cell_multi_last_win_rate 0.231 vs nonlast 0.015), so the rejection is reproducible with zero memory. The no-key conclusion stands, but the conclusion as stated exceeds the evidence.

issues.evidence: Reproduced from repair_n1_memoryless_minute.csv: N1 (2,000 draws) run on 100 memoryless streams with outcome-tied duration rejects on 100/100 streams (median min Holm p 0.0070 — identical to the real 0.0070), with positive excess on all six threshold tests in 100% of streams (means +84 to +119 INR/trade vs the real +53 to +106; Spearman excess -0.0236 vs real -0.0233); with duration independent of outcome it rejects on 6/100 (excess +2 to +5). Hindsight-free re-tests on minute/L1 (repair_null_tests_minute_L1.csv): N3 min Holm p 1.0 (observed statistics at memoryless percentiles 20-65), N4 min Holm p 1.0 (every 90% session-block-bootstrap CI covers zero; stratified stat = OLS hour-FE coefficient exactly, repair_n4_ols_crosscheck_minute.csv; cluster-robust p 0.31-0.95); L0 N4 min Holm p 1.0. results_repair.json timeframes.minute.L1.decision = 'NOT REJECTED under N3 or N4 -> no session memory shown beyond the hour effect, no key'. The as-run FINDINGS reading of control_pct 0.0 ('the rule does worse than picking the same number of same-session SETUPs at random') is likewise contradicted: on memoryless streams the k=2/L=none rule has session-matched control pct median 0.0 (tied) / 0.25 (indep), share <=5th pct 1.00 / 0.85 (I2: hindsight-biased comparator). write_findings.py on disk (line 2, 13, 199 sec_repair) is the repaired generator that reads results_repair.json but was never run: FINDINGS.md (HEAD 9a1f988, 'generated by write_findings.py from results.json') and findings.json have no repair block; STUDY_AGENT_BRIEF.md line 72-73 lists exactly this step as still to do, yet the study was reported completed with the withdrawn claim as 'the one new fact for the playbook'.
